Salt/pepper remain the documented to-taste minimum booking; water-or-chile-liquid remains deliberately unbooked and referenced in step 2. Pricing-quality flags in the DATA SMELLS note (bell-pepper class, shredded-cheese cell hijacks, 27 oz can conservatism) are the batch auditor's cost domain, carried not judged here.
